purpose: One bounded physical acceptance: dashboard -> physical Right -> looping animation -> physical Left -> live dashboard, then Runtime 005 restored.

target.transport: existing typed activity-session Host only (127.0.0.1:8796); no second RFCOMM controller

animation.provenance: procedural 5-colour rotating spiral on black, generated offline once; 147-byte image groups (dashboard ~194)

run.sequence: scripts/pagination_acceptance.sh: settle >=30 s, stop openditoo-product.service, Host idle, 8 s settle, start ButtonProbe, pagination-run, stop probe, restart Runtime 005 service

session.note: identical to the granted Runtime 005 local policy

behavior.input_source: ButtonProbe NDJSON, source=smtc only, read-only consumer
behavior.why_reclaim_within_window: BTN-2: an arrow press can end the Host session (RFCOMM 0x09); page state survives in the router and the next session resumes it. Same reclaim/backoff as Runtime 005, bounded by the 300 s window
behavior.no_retry_of_this_experiment: the O_EXCL claim is consumed before any device I/O; a failed or ambiguous run needs a new id and grant

acceptance: one physical Right -> one nav_right -> animation visible and visibly running
one physical Left -> one nav_left -> live MCP dashboard restored
one genuine MCP activity pulse renders on the restored dashboard
no double page event; no stock screen from arrows; clean stop and Runtime 005 restored
measure: event multiplicity, applied-to-first-ACK latency, session identity

authority.does_not_authorize: standing pagination (Runtime 006), lever actions, webcam changes, any other display
